# dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout
**An AI agent that drives Cadence Virtuoso to draw layout — packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.**

12 host-side tools, zero runtime dependencies, driving **Virtuoso 6.1.7-64b** inside a
RHEL 6.5 VMwa

re guest. Verified end to end on a real SMIC 0.18 µm process: the layout it
produced passes Calibre

**DRC** with zero geometry violations and passes **LVS** as a
recognised `<model>` device.

## The write gate

`lib/guard.js` installs a single global tool guard that denies mutating
`virtuoso_eval` / `virtuoso_

run` calls unless they carry a stateless, sha256-derived
`confirm` token.

The contract was read out of the harness, and it shaped the whole design: a guard is
**synchronous**

(it cannot wait for a human), it runs **after** the pre-execute
waterfall, it **can only deny** — i
t can never force a call through. So the design is:

- **Read-only calls are never gated.** `dbOpenCellViewByType(… "r")`, `cv~>shapes`,
`sleep; echo` pa

ss untouched — otherwise the gate trains you to paste tokens without
looking.
- **Fail-closed.** If

the sandbox policy cannot be read, the guard denies.
- **`confirm: true` is deliberately rejected.**

That is a rubber stamp, not consent.
- **`danger-full-access` abstains**, because the user already

granted full write
authority — and `virtuoso_status` reports `enforcedNow` so the gate is observable

ranted full write
authority — and `virtuoso_status` reports `enforcedNow` so the gate is observable.

Verified live in four cases: deny → token → allow, wrong token, read-only exempt, and
abstain under

e in four cases: deny → token → allow, wrong token, read-only exempt, and
abstain under full access.

## Requirements

- **Cadence Virtuoso** with a licensed install (this was developed against 6.1.7-64b)
- A Linux gues

t reachable over passwordless SSH, in VMware or similar
- A technology library to bind to
- **Calibr

e** for DRC/LVS (optional; the plugin can drive Virtuoso without it)
- Node.js (the plugin uses **on

ly Node builtins** — no `npm install`)
- DeepSeek Harness

Without Virtuoso and a PDK this plugin has nothing to drive. It is published because the
**technique

** — turning an opaque EDA tool into a programmable, verifiable, documented
interface — transfers to
any tool with a scripting layer.
